<!-- ТУТ САЙТ КАРТОЧКА ЭТО ПРОСТО ТАТУ -->
<!-- <!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="ru">
<head>
  <meta name="yandex-verification" content="bcd366bd3847d8fa" />
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1, viewport-fit=cover" />
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#050505" />
  <title>Это просто татуировка</title>

  <style>
    :root {
      --bg: #050505;
      --bg-soft: #0d0d0d;
      --text: #f5f5f0;
      --muted: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.60);
      --muted-2: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.38);
      --line: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08);
      --line-2: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.14);
      --glass: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.04);
      --glass-2: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.025);
      --shadow:
        0 24px 90px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.52),
        0 0 80px rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.035);
      --radius: clamp(22px, 3vw, 30px);

      --safe-top: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-top));
      --safe-right: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-right));
      --safe-bottom: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
      --safe-left: max(16px, env(safe-area-inset-left));
    }

    *,
    *::before,
    *::after {
      box-sizing: border-box;
    }

    html {
      -webkit-text-size-adjust: 100%;
      text-size-adjust: 100%;
      scroll-behavior: smooth;
    }

    body {
      margin: 0;
      min-width: 320px;
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: 100svh;
      color: var(--text);
      font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 18% 16%, #171717 0%, #0b0b0b 28%, #040404 58%, #010101 100%);
      overflow-x: hidden;
      position: relative;
    }

    @supports (min-height: 100dvh) {
      body {
        min-height: 100dvh;
      }
    }

    .bg,
    .noise,
    .grid,
    .vignette,
    .glow-a,
    .glow-b {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      user-select: none;
    }

    .bg {
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 22% 24%, rgba(255,255,255,0.045), transparent 22%),
        radial-gradient(circle at 76% 70%, rgba(255,255,255,0.032), transparent 20%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.012), transparent 40%);
      filter: blur(12px);
      animation: bgFloat 16s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    .glow-a {
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 45% 24%, rgba(255,255,255,0.080), transparent 24%);
      filter: blur(20px);
      animation: driftA 14s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    .glow-b {
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at 70% 72%, rgba(255,255,255,0.052), transparent 22%);
      filter: blur(24px);
      animation: driftB 18s ease-in-out infinite alternate;
    }

    .noise {
      opacity: 0.04;
      background-image:
        repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 0 0, transparent 0, transparent 2px, rgba(255,255,255,0.58) 3px),
        repeating-radial-gradient(circle at 100% 100%, transparent 0, transparent 2px, rgba(255,255,255,0.28) 3px);
      background-size: 180px 180px, 220px 220px;
      mix-blend-mode: soft-light;
    }

    .grid {
      opacity: 0.055;
      background-image:
        linear-gradient(rgba(255,255,255,0.08) 1px, transparent 1px),
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.08) 1px, transparent 1px);
      background-size: 28px 28px;
      -webkit-mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at center, black 28%, transparent 88%);
      mask-image: radial-gradient(circle at center, black 28%, transparent 88%);
    }

    .vignette {
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at center, transparent 32%, rgba(0,0,0,0.36) 72%, rgba(0,0,0,0.72) 100%);
    }

    @keyframes bgFloat {
      from { transform: translate3d(-8px, -6px, 0) scale(1); }
      to   { transform: translate3d(10px, 10px, 0) scale(1.03); }
    }

    @keyframes driftA {
      from { transform: translate3d(-12px, -10px, 0) scale(1); }
      to   { transform: translate3d(16px, 14px, 0) scale(1.06); }
    }

    @keyframes driftB {
      from { transform: translate3d(10px, -8px, 0) scale(1); }
      to   { transform: translate3d(-14px, 18px, 0) scale(1.05); }
    }

    .page {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      min-height: 100vh;
      min-height: 100svh;
      display: grid;
      place-items: center;
      padding:
        calc(var(--safe-top) + 10px)
        var(--safe-right)
        calc(var(--safe-bottom) + 58px)
        var(--safe-left);
    }

    @supports (min-height: 100dvh) {
      .page {
        min-height: 100dvh;
      }
    }

    .wrap {
      width: min(100%, 640px);
    }

    .card {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      overflow: hidden;
      border-radius: var(--radius);
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      background:
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.05), rgba(255,255,255,0.017)),
        linear-gradient(135deg, rgba(255,255,255,0.02), rgba(255,255,255,0.01)),
        var(--glass-2);
      box-shadow:
        inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.018),
        var(--shadow);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(120%);
      backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(120%);
      isolation: isolate;
    }

    .card::before {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        linear-gradient(
          115deg,
          transparent 0%,
          transparent 18%,
          rgba(255,255,255,0.065) 27%,
          rgba(255,255,255,0.020) 33%,
          transparent 42%,
          transparent 100%
        );
      transform: translateX(-130%);
      animation: sheen 8s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) infinite;
      z-index: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    .card::after {
      content: "";
      position: absolute;
      inset: 1px;
      border-radius: inherit;
      background:
        radial-gradient(circle at top left, rgba(255,255,255,0.06), transparent 36%);
      opacity: 0.75;
      z-index: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    @keyframes sheen {
      0%, 74% { transform: translateX(-130%); }
      100%    { transform: translateX(150%); }
    }

    .topline,
    .content {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }

    .topline {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 16px 28px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line);
      color: var(--muted);
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.2;
      letter-spacing: 0.09em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    .dots {
      display: inline-flex;
      gap: 6px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .dot {
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.18);
      box-shadow: 0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,0.05);
    }

    .content {
      padding: clamp(18px, 4vw, 28px);
    }

    .label {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
      max-width: 100%;
      margin-bottom: 18px;
      padding: 8px 12px;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: var(--glass);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.74);
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.2;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      white-space: nowrap;
      box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.015);
    }

    .label::before {
      content: "";
      width: 8px;
      height: 8px;
      flex: 0 0 8px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.88);
      box-shadow:
        0 0 0 3px rgba(255,255,255,0.035),
        0 0 14px rgba(255,255,255,0.36);
      animation: pulse 2.4s ease-in-out infinite;
    }

    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% {
        transform: scale(0.92);
        opacity: 0.72;
      }
      50% {
        transform: scale(1.22);
        opacity: 1;
      }
    }

    h1 {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: clamp(36px, 8vw, 72px);
      line-height: 0.94;
      letter-spacing: -0.055em;
      font-weight: 800;
      text-wrap: balance;
    }

    .line {
      display: block;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(16px);
      animation: rise 0.82s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) forwards;
      will-change: transform, opacity;
    }

    .line:nth-child(2) {
      animation-delay: 0.16s;
    }

    @keyframes rise {
      to {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: translateY(0);
      }
    }

    .desc {
      margin: 18px 0 0;
      max-width: 34ch;
      font-size: clamp(15px, 2.8vw, 16px);
      line-height: 1.62;
      color: var(--muted);
      text-wrap: pretty;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(14px);
      animation: rise 0.82s 0.32s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) forwards;
    }

    .divider {
      height: 1px;
      margin: 22px 0 18px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, rgba(255,255,255,0.18), transparent);
      opacity: 0;
      animation: fadeIn 1s 0.5s ease forwards;
    }

    @keyframes fadeIn {
      to { opacity: 1; }
    }

    .quote {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: clamp(13px, 2.5vw, 14px);
      line-height: 1.72;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.8);
      text-wrap: pretty;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(10px);
      animation: rise 0.82s 0.66s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) forwards;
    }

    .quote strong {
      color: #fff;
      font-weight: 700;
    }

    .footer {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-end;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: 14px;
      margin-top: 28px;
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(12px);
      animation: rise 0.82s 0.84s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1) forwards;
    }

    .micro {
      max-width: 28ch;
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.55;
      color: var(--muted-2);
      text-wrap: pretty;
    }

    .chip {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      min-height: 40px;
      padding: 10px 12px;
      border: 1px solid var(--line);
      border-radius: 999px;
      background: rgba(255,255,255,0.03);
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.78);
      font-size: 12px;
      line-height: 1.2;
      white-space: nowrap;
      box-shadow:
        inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(255,255,255,0.012),
        0 0 26px rgba(255,255,255,0.02);
    }

    .hint {
      position: fixed;
      left: 50%;
      bottom: max(14px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom));
      transform: translateX(-50%);
      z-index: 2;
      width: calc(100% - 32px);
      max-width: 420px;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 11px;
      line-height: 1.35;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: rgba(255,255,255,0.28);
      text-wrap: balance;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    @media (max-width: 420px) {
      .page {
        padding:
          calc(var(--safe-top) + 10px)
          14px
          calc(var(--safe-bottom) + 54px)
          14px;
      }

      .topline {
        padding: 12px 14px;
        font-size: 10px;
      }

      .content {
        padding: 18px 16px;
      }

      .label {
        font-size: 11px;
        padding: 8px 11px;
      }

      .footer {
        flex-direction: column;
        align-items: flex-start;
      }

      .chip {
        white-space: normal;
      }
    }

    @media (max-height: 700px) {
      .page {
        place-items: start center;
      }

      .wrap {
        margin-top: 8px;
      }
    }

    @media (max-height: 520px) and (orientation: landscape) {
      .page {
        padding-top: var(--safe-top);
        padding-bottom: calc(var(--safe-bottom) + 42px);
      }

      .topline {
        padding: 10px 14px;
      }

      .content {
        padding: 16px;
      }

      h1 {
        font-size: clamp(30px, 5vw, 48px);
      }

      .desc,
      .quote {
        font-size: 13px;
        line-height: 1.5;
      }

      .divider {
        margin: 16px 0 14px;
      }

      .footer {
        margin-top: 18px;
      }

      .hint {
        font-size: 10px;
      }
    }

    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      html {
        scroll-behavior: auto;
      }

      *,
      *::before,
      *::after {
        animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
        transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      }

      .line,
      .desc,
      .quote,
      .footer,
      .divider {
        opacity: 1 !important;
        transform: none !important;
      }
    }

    @supports not ((backdrop-filter: blur(16px)) or (-webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(16px))) {
      .card {
        background:
          linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(18,18,18,0.94), rgba(8,8,8,0.96));
      }
    }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <div class="bg" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="glow-a" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="glow-b" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="noise" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="grid" aria-hidden="true"></div>
  <div class="vignette" aria-hidden="true"></div>

  <main class="page">
    <div class="wrap">
      <section class="card" aria-labelledby="title">
        <div class="topline">
          <span>scanned object</span>
          <div class="dots" aria-hidden="true">
            <span class="dot"></span>
            <span class="dot"></span>
            <span class="dot"></span>
          </div>
        </div>

        <div class="content">
          <div class="label">ничего секретного</div>

          <h1 id="title">
            <span class="line">это просто</span>
            <span class="line">татуировка</span>
          </h1>

          <p class="desc">
            Ты правда это отсканировал. Уважаю.
            Тут нет скрытого клуба, загадки века или доступа к матрице.
            Просто татуировка, которая решила стать цифровым объектом.
          </p>

          <div class="divider" aria-hidden="true"></div>

          <p class="quote">
            Иногда <strong>прикол</strong> — это уже достаточная причина что-то сделать.
          </p>

          <div class="footer">
            <div class="micro">
              этот экран существует только потому, что кто-то однажды решил:
              а почему бы и нет
            </div>
            <div class="chip" id="time-chip" aria-live="polite">live object</div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  </main>

  <div class="hint">made of ink and bad decisions</div>

  <script>
    (function () {
      const chip = document.getElementById("time-chip");
      if (!chip) return;

      const hour = new Date().getHours();
      let text = "live object";

      if (hour >= 5 && hour < 12) {
        text = "доброе утро";
      } else if (hour >= 12 && hour < 18) {
        text = "добрый день";
      } else if (hour >= 18 && hour < 24) {
        text = "добрый вечер";
      } else {
        text = "поздновато";
      }

      chip.textContent = text;
    })();
  </script>
</body>
</html> -->
